items.source: The test above has changed the spring.foo property to biz and is asserting that the context contains a single MyBean bean. The run method takes a ContextConsumer that can apply assertions to the context. Upon completion, the context is automatically closed.
items.translation: 上面的测试已将 `spring.foo` 属性更改为 `biz`，并断言上下文包含单个 `MyBean` Bean。run 方法接受一个 ContextConsumer，该对象可对上下文应用断言。完成后，上下文将自动关闭。

items.source: If the application context fails to start the #run(ContextConsumer) method is called with a "failed" application context. Calls to the context will throw an IllegalStateException and assertions that expect a running context will fail. The getFailure() assertion can be used if further checks are required on the cause of the failure:
items.translation: 如果应用程序上下文启动失败，则调用 `#run(ContextConsumer)` 方法时传入一个“失败”的应用程序上下文。对上下文的调用将抛出 IllegalStateException，且期望运行中上下文的断言将会失败。如果需要对失败原因进行进一步检查，可以使用 getFailure() 断言：

items.source: The initialization above makes sure to register MyConfiguration for all tests and set the spring.foo property to bar unless specified otherwise.
items.translation: 上面的初始化确保为所有测试注册了 `MyConfiguration`，并将 `spring.foo` 属性设置为 `bar`，除非另有指定。

items.source: Prepare a new ApplicationContext based on the current state of this loader. The context is consumed by the specified consumer and closed upon completion. Unlike run(ContextConsumer), this method does not refresh the consumed context.
items.translation: 基于此加载器的当前状态，准备一个新的 ApplicationContext。该上下文由指定的 consumer 消费，并在完成后关闭。与 run(ContextConsumer) 不同，此方法不会刷新所消费的上下文。

items.source: Customize the ClassLoader that the ApplicationContext should use for resource loading and bean class loading.
items.translation: 自定义 ClassLoader，供 ApplicationContext 用于资源加载和 Bean 类加载。

items.source: Configure the parent of the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 配置 `parent` 的 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: Add the specified System property pairs. Key-value pairs can be specified with colon (":") or equals ("=") separators. System properties are added before the context is run and restored when the context is closed.
items.translation: 添加指定的System属性对。键值对可以使用冒号（":"）或等号（"="）分隔符指定。系统属性会在上下文run之前添加，并在上下文关闭时恢复。

items.source: Create and refresh a new ApplicationContext based on the current state of this loader. The context is consumed by the specified consumer and closed upon completion.
items.translation: 创建并刷新一个基于当前加载器状态的新的ApplicationContext。该上下文由指定的consumer消费，并在完成后关闭。

items.source: Register the specified configuration classes with the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 将指定的配置类注册到ApplicationContext。

items.translation: 添加一个 `ApplicationContextInitializer`，以便在上下文创建时调用。

items.source: Register the specified user configuration classes with the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 将指定的用户配置类注册到ApplicationContext。

items.source: Add the specified Environment property pairs. Key-value pairs can be specified with colon (":") or equals ("=") separators. Override matching keys that might have been specified previously.
items.translation: 添加指定的 Environment 属性对。键值对可以使用冒号 (":") 或等号 ("=") 分隔符指定。覆盖之前可能已指定的匹配键。
